evidence.why: Complete display-copy state transitions and restoration.
Independent blend, logic, color/alpha-update, depth and comparison-location field definitions.

facts.rationale: Corrects the mistaken identification of cmode0 bits 0 and 1 as color/alpha-update enables. GXPixel independently identifies those bits as blending and logic-operation enables and places color/alpha updates at bits 3 and 4. The replacement preserves the distinct conditional overrides and restoration lifetime.
facts.value: After the GXBegin guard and DEBUG-only copy verification, a nonzero clear argument causes temporary register writes enabling depth comparison with comparison code 7 and disabling blending and logic operations through cmode0 bits 0 and 1. The cached depth-update and color/alpha-update fields are preserved; color and alpha updates are not disabled by this branch. Independently, if clearing or the cached pixel-format code is 3, and peCtrl bit 6 is set, a temporary peCtrl clears bit 6. The function emits the configured display-copy command, restores cached zmode and cmode0 when clearing and peCtrl when temporarily changed, and sets gx->bpSent to 0. Temporary pixel-engine values do not overwrite their cached originals, while the copy-control shadow retains the command-field updates. Command submission does not wait for copy completion.

evidence.why: Ordered temporary-state changes, command submission and restoration.
Shared DEBUG verifier explicitly reads display-copy shadows.
Caller separately performs optional synchronization and texture invalidation.

facts.rationale: Corrects the same blend/logic-versus-update-field error and makes the ordered depth-copy overrides explicit without collapsing numeric format state or the exceptional DEBUG verification behavior.
facts.value: After the GXBegin guard and DEBUG-only shared copy verification, a nonzero clear argument temporarily enables depth comparison with comparison code 7 and disables blending and logic operations through cmode0 bits 0 and 1, preserving the cached depth-update and color/alpha-update fields. Starting from cached peCtrl, a nonzero cpTexZ changes the temporary low three bits to numeric pixel-format code 3 when necessary. Then, if clearing or the temporary format is 3, bit 6 is cleared when set. The temporary peCtrl is emitted only if either change occurred. After submitting texture-copy geometry, destination and control state, the routine restores cached zmode/cmode0 when clearing and cached peCtrl when changed, then sets gx->bpSent to 0. The cached pixel-engine originals remain intact; copy-control command fields persist. The DEBUG verifier reads display-copy shadows rather than texture-copy shadows. No completion wait or texture-cache invalidation occurs here.
